jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst Company:
Golden Dream Properties & Investments
Group: Bafleh Jewellery Group

Location:
Dubai, UAE

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
to join our team as a Financial Analyst
.
Key Responsibilities:

Prepare and analyse financial reports
Monitor company performance, cash flow, and expenses.
Prepare financial models and investment analysis.
Analyse variances and provide financial insights to management.
Support investment and business decision-making.
Assist with audits, reporting, and other finance-related activities.

Requirements:

CA qualification is mandatory.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
3+ years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, or investment.
Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in real estate or investments
will be an advantage.
